evidenceContract.userBehavior: Ask for a generic creative-planning direction in English without an explicit Skill gesture and receive the first useful layer from the same canonical Skill.

observables.description: Exact implicit Skill receipt, configured model and a concise English result from the same canonical content-authoring identity.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The model selects content-authoring from its Chinese-first bilingual description and returns one direction, the decisive evidence limit and one next action in English.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: No Skill receipt, a localized duplicate Skill identity, a Chinese response, or a complete proposal outline fails.

steps.prompt: I only have an unapproved creative concept; its scope, evidence, and deliverable format are still undecided. Use only Direction, Evidence, and Next step to give me the smallest useful planning conclusion. Do not write a complete proposal, alternatives, or detailed execution steps yet.
